ShortsMaker Viral is independent and not affiliated with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Facebook. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

ShortsMaker Viral processes your videos on your device.

• Your videos, transcripts and projects are stored only in the app's private storage. They are never uploaded to any server of ours.
• Transcription (Vosk) and face detection (MediaPipe) run locally. Voice models are downloaded once from alphacephei.com.
• If you paste a YouTube, Twitch or Kick link, the app reads that page's public data on your device (title, duration and, on YouTube, most-replayed moments). No video or stream is downloaded: you always edit the file you choose. Without a link, all analysis uses the local transcript.
• Ads: the app shows a Google AdMob banner on some screens. AdMob may use your device's advertising ID and device data to serve ads and measure performance. Where required by law (EEA, UK) we ask for your consent and you can change it in Settings → Ad privacy options. You can reset or delete your advertising ID in Android settings. More info: policies.google.com/technologies/ads.
• No accounts or first-party analytics.
• The exported video only leaves the app when you tap Save or Share.
• You can delete projects and models in Settings at any time.

When using third-party videos you are responsible for holding the necessary rights.
